content.text: 找到目标文件 `340M-20B-GatedDeltaNet-New-hybrid-24-1.json`。提取 lambada 结果。

input.command:
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
import json

# GDN-New-hybrid-24-1
with open('/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/340m/340M-20B-GatedDeltaNet-New-hybrid-24-1.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
r = data.get('results', {})
print('=== 340M-20B-GatedDeltaNet-New-hybrid-24-1 ===')
print('All benchmarks:', list(r.keys()))
lambada = r.get('lambada_openai', {})
print(f'lambada_openai acc: {lambada.get(\"acc,none\", \"N/A\")}')
print(f'lambada_openai ppl: {lambada.get(\"perplexity,none\", \"N/A\")}')
print()

# All GDN files
import glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/340m/*GatedDeltaNet*.json')):
    with open(f) as fh:
        d = json.load(fh)
    res = d.get('results', {})
    print(f'=== {f.split(\"/\")[-1]} ===')
    print('Benchmarks:', list(res.keys()))
    lam = res.get('lambada_openai', {})
    print(f'  lambada acc: {lam.get(\"acc,none\", \"N/A\")}')
    print(f'  lambada ppl: {lam.get(\"perplexity,none\", \"N/A\")}')
    print()
"
